#OD/MapEngine/5
# OUTBREAK -- a thing that takes ground and cannot be negotiated with.
#
# Generated by tools/outbreak/make_outbreak.py. The only lines it fills in are
# patient zero's provinces, because an id is the one thing a script cannot
# compute; everything else reads the world it was loaded into and would run
# unchanged on another map.
#
# THE WHOLE MECHANIC IS SCRIPT. The engine gained two loops and a die for it
# -- foreach neighbour, foreach province in array.NAME, random.N -- and
# nothing else. There is no outbreak code in the game, no new turn phase, no
# special case: an outbreak is a country that moves by itself.

# ── Dials ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# chance: the % chance of crossing into an open province each turn.
# fortSlows: that chance is divided by this where fortifications stand.
# A trailing comment on a statement line is NOT stripped -- the engine reads
# the whole line -- so these sit above, not beside.
set var.chance = __CHANCE__
set var.fortSlows = __FORTS__

# ── Patient zero ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# IDEMPOTENT ON PURPOSE. A suspended script is not saved: loading a save runs
# this file again from the top. The outbreak's state is the MAP -- who owns
# what, which every save already stores -- so a re-run must not start it over.
# If it holds ground, it has already begun.
if country.PLG.province_count == 0
__SEEDS__
  print "[outbreak] it begins in __SEED_NAME__"
endif

# ── One turn, one ring ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
label spread

# SCAN. Collect the frontier, and change nothing while looking at it.
array create front
foreach province in country.PLG
  foreach neighbour in province
    # "" is nobody's -- unclaimed, or blocked. The outbreak does not cross
    # ground the game itself holds shut.
    if province.owner != "PLG" and province.owner != ""
      set var.roll = var.chance
      if province.fortification > 0
        set var.roll = var.chance / var.fortSlows
      endif
      if random.100 < var.roll
        array push front province.id
      endif
    endif
  next
next

# APPLY. The scan is closed, so nothing infected this turn can infect again
# until the next one. Both in one pass would let the front cross the map in a
# single turn instead of advancing one ring.
set var.took = 0
foreach province in array.front
  if province.owner != "PLG"
    set province.owner to "PLG"
    set var.took = var.took + 1
  endif
next

if var.took > 0
  print "[outbreak] turn {map.turn}: {var.took} more, {country.PLG.province_count} in all"
endif

wait 1 turns
jump spread
